task.title: Inputs required — Active or terminated claim

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 3.

If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated:
On the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Click Reactivate .
Go to step 2.
If the claim is terminated and cannot be reactivated, go to Inputs required — Blocked claim . Inputs required — Blocked claim

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for inputting the claimant’s report:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Input the claimant’s report.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 3.

step.cmd: Determine if any of the claimant’s reports requiring input are before a renewal week for which claimant’s reports have already been processed:
In FTS, determine if a revised registration number exists for the claimant’s report issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .
Go to step 5.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the registration number for the claimant’s report issue.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the claimant’s report to be input.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 26 - Processing of a report blocked by a renewal week .
Remarks line 1: Type “P/R claimant’s report before a processed renewal week.”

Remarks line 2: Type the appropriate option:
“Process [XXXX] nil and available.”
“Process [XXXX] as [FWW or FW] M152, [weeks and amounts for FWW or FW if necessary].”
Remarks line 4: Enter your name and telephone number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Determine if the client declared a condition on the Claimant’s report: Original with pay coding — Checklist that requires paycoding:
In FTS, select the Issue Payments (M151/M152) transaction and input the claimant’s reports as follows:

ul.li: Select: Check one or more boxes based on the claimant’s reports being input.
Report Period: Select the Sunday of the start week of the claimant’s report to be processed.
Weeks: Select 1 for a 1-week claimant’s report or 2 for a 2-week claimant’s report.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Issue Payments (M151/M152) transaction and input the claimant’s reports as follows:

ul.li: Select: Check one or more boxes based on the number of claimant’s reports being input.
Report Period: Select the Sunday of the start week of the claimant’s report to be processed.
Weeks: Select 1 for a 1-week claimant’s report or 2 for a 2-week claimant’s report.
Coding: Click No. When the Detailed Claimant’s Report (M152) transaction opens, select the appropriate option in the Found work or Full work week field, if necessary.

Full work week: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Full work week in week 1
2 - Full work week in week 2
3 - Full work week both weeks

Found work: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Found work on Sunday or Monday of week 1 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday) — No other earnings coding is required.
2 - Found work on Sunday or Monday of week 2 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday) — Code any earnings for week 1. No other coding is required for week 2.
3 - Found work on Monday of the week following week 2 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday).
4 - Found work after Monday in the first week — Code the earnings for week 1.
5 - Found work after Monday in the second week — Code the earnings for week 2.
6 - No further reports to be issued - client indicated they no longer wish to receive benefits .
Note Note

step.cmd: Determine if additional claimant’s reports must be input:
In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for this issue:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if a WI exists for the claimant’s report issue:

ul.li: If no, return to the initial task.
